falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes above $73,500 on any daily candle
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakout above the 2019 mini-top analog's implied resistance ceiling would invalidate the HOLD verdict and the 76% pattern match, signaling a new impulse leg rather than distribution.

falsification_conditions.condition: Total altcoin market cap (excluding BTC and ETH) rises more than 25% in 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 2019 mini-top pattern was characterized by altcoin underperformance and rotation into BTC. Broad speculative altcoin strength would contradict the blowoff score of 55 and suggest risk appetite is expanding, not topping.

falsification_conditions.condition: BTC funding rate on Binance stays below 0.005% for 7 consecutive days while price makes a higher high
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained rally with low leverage demand would falsify the blowoff thesis, which requires overheated perp positioning. This would indicate organic spot accumulation rather than a leveraged top.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
